data.name: Prerna
data.long_meaning: Prerna is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'prarodh', meaning 'to inspire, to set in motion'. It signifies the feeling of inspiration or the sense of direction and aim, a deep-rooted desire to achieve something. In Hindu mythology, Prerna is believed to represent the inner voice that guides us towards our life's purpose.
